answer: Operator Escrow Liability: each agent identity is backed by an escrow the operator posts per identity. Identity creation and every action pass a kernel check binding the identity to that escrow; a sybil cluster crossing a variance threshold triggers forfeiture of the operator's entire escrow pool plus a freeze on new registrations. Costs scale per identity, not per wallet. An opal rating gates escrow release, and hollow-looking clusters get audited.
